title: FoodFiesta

listing.shortDescription: A food ordering app with menu browsing, cart, profiles and map context — React and MUI frontend with an Express, session-auth and MySQL backend.
listing.fullDescription: FoodFiesta is a food ordering platform that treats the whole experience as one flow. Customers explore a menu, build a cart, manage their profile and order — with Leaflet maps adding location context and Material UI giving the app a familiar, polished feel. The Express backend handles sessions, uploads and the MySQL data layer.

closing.clientOverview: Personal project — full-stack food ordering build
closing.conclusion: FoodFiesta lets customers explore a menu, build a cart and order, with map-based context and profile management — a complete food-ordering experience in one codebase.
